name: Amla Powder
description: High-quality, natural Amla powder rich in Vitamin C and antioxidants.
longDescription: Our premium Amla (Indian Gooseberry) powder is carefully sourced from organically grown gooseberries in India. Known as a superfruit in Ayurveda, Amla is one of the richest natural sources of Vitamin C and powerful antioxidants. Our cold-processing technique preserves the full nutritional profile, delivering a fine, aromatic powder that blends seamlessly into your daily routine.

name: Mango Powder
description: Tangy and sweet natural mango powder (Amchur).

Beyond cooking, our mango powder is rich in vitamins and is increasingly used in health foods, smoothies, and supplements.

name: Jackfruit Powder
description: A sweet, tropical flavor naturally derived from Jackfruit.
longDescription: Our Jackfruit Powder is crafted from ripe jackfruit pulp harvested from tropical plantations in South India. The fruit is carefully dehydrated and milled into a fine, aromatic powder that retains its signature tropical sweetness and creamy texture notes. Jackfruit is one of the largest tree-borne fruits in the world and is valued for its unique flavor, high fiber content, and versatility in both sweet and savory dishes.

name: Moringa Powder
description: Nutrient-dense superfood powder packed with vitamins.
longDescription: Our Moringa Powder is made from the leaves of the Moringa Oleifera tree, often called the 'Miracle Tree' for its extraordinary nutritional profile. Moringa has been used in traditional medicine for thousands of years and is now recognized globally as one of the most nutrient-dense superfoods available.
